entity: Florida freestanding inpatient rehab hospitals, growth since the mid-2019 CON repeal
what_we_add: the counts: 17 to 40 (+135%), 23 new hospitals and 1,144 beds with zero closures, net +24 most of any state, rest of US +31%
why: Modern Healthcare and KFF name Florida and report the same finding in words: a rehab-hospital building rush after the CON repeal, over a dozen facilities and 800+ beds. No source has the 17-to-40 count, the zero-closures fact, or the rest-of-US comparison.
